name: Music tuition & teachers (category guide)
summary: Piano / violin home teachers vs academies — ABRSM path honesty, trial-lesson traps, and expat-kid rate bands without the hard sell.
body: Expat families shop Yamaha/Cristofori-style academies against freelance home teachers charging roughly SGD 70–100+/hr depending on level and language. Ask about exam board pathway (ABRSM/Trinity), make-up lesson policy, and whether the teacher holds a diploma if you want graded progress — Grade 8 alone is not a teaching credential. Trial lessons should not auto-enrol a term package; get fees, instrument rental, and notice periods in writing. Condo rules may limit evening practising volume for neighbours. Distinct from school enrichment and from sports coaching. Category guide, not a ranked teacher directory.
